name: golang-developer
description: Go microservices development with Clean Architecture, GORM, gRPC + grpc-gateway, Google Wire DI, NATS JetStream, Redis, MySQL. Covers scaffolding, code review, debugging, testing, architecture guidance, restructuring existing projects to the target layout, and a strict proto workflow (buf lint mandatory pre-commit, protoc-go-inject-tag for validate/json struct tags, never edit *.pb.go by hand).
